about: Vectors for MPP's challenge pieces in the mpp entry point of @integraledger/lcp, shared by every MPP pairing. H is SHA-256("abc") from FIPS 180-2. C_E and C_T are fixed challenges; their request values are JSON, base64url without padding. Expected values were computed with eth-account 0.14.0, eth-abi 6.0.0, eth-utils 6.0.0 and pyrlp 5.0.0 on Python 3.12.3, viem 2.57.4 and GNU coreutils 9.4. MV9's field values are MPP's own example (draft-httpauth-payment-01 at 08e7dd87, lines 1427-1430).

credentialSize.about: The credential size bound, as bound measures a credential before it reads it and as each pairing's complete measures the credential it would return. A credential is measured as JSON: a string counts its UTF-16 code units plus 2; a number, boolean or null 8; an array 2 plus its items; and an object 2 plus, for each member, its name's UTF-16 code units plus 3 and its value. A credential of at most 65,536 is within the bound, and one over it is mpp/credential-malformed. Each row is a size, run against every pairing whose build returns a complete that makes a credential: the EVM authorization, permit2, transaction and hash charges, the Tempo memo and push charges, the Lightning charge and session, the Solana, Stellar and XRPL charges, the usdc evm, solana, stacks and gateway profiles, the EVM, Tempo, Hedera, Solana and XRPL sessions and the Tempo subscription. A pairing's credential is the one its build and complete give on its vector file's B2 inputs and the complete input that file's B6 payment carries; the EVM transaction and hash charges, which have no B6 row, complete a transaction of 100 bytes of 0x11 and H; the Solana and Stellar charges complete a signature of 64 bytes of 0x11, which they do not verify; and the Tempo subscription completes the root key's signature over its digest. The challenge is the file's placed challenge, B6's where there is one, with a description of as many characters as bring that credential to the row's size: no pairing reads or hashes the description, so it leaves the challenge's id, H and every value the payer signs as they are. At a size marked taken, complete returns the credential, and bound answers it as it answers that credential without the description: H, or mpp/no-signed-place on the EVM transaction and hash charges, and tempo/read-first and hedera/read-first on the Tempo push charge and the Hedera session, whose payment bound reads only once it has landed; over the bound, complete refuses with the row's code, and bound refuses the credential complete would have given with it.

completeOrder.about: A build's complete checks the credential it would return in its bound's order. bound measures a credential (credentialSize) before it reads the payment it carries, so complete, given a payment with a fault it reads under a challenge that puts that credential over the credential size bound, gives mpp/credential-malformed, as bound gives that credential; at the bound, complete gives the fault's own code, and bound the row's bound code where it does not read the fault, or H where boundTakes is true (bound reads nothing of a Lightning preimage). Each row names a pairing and a fault; the challenge is the pairing's credentialSize challenge, padded by a description so that the credential complete would make of the faulty payment measures the row's size, and bound is given that credential. The faults: on mpp/charge/stellar a signed envelope of 8,200 characters (mpp-charge-stellar.json completeXdr row 2's); on mpp/charge/usdc/stacks a transaction of 16,385 bytes (mpp-charge-usdc-stacks.json agreedRefusals row 48's wire); on mpp/subscription/tempo a root signature of 8,192 bytes of 0x11, whose signed key authorization is over 8,192 bytes; on mpp/charge/xrpl a blob of 2,049 zero bytes; on mpp/charge/evm/transaction an EIP-1559 transaction for chain 1 (mpp-charge-evm-transaction.json agreedRefusals row 0's first); on mpp/charge/lightning the preimage 00.

voucherSize.about: A session build's voucher measures the credential its complete would give with the shortest voucher signature complete takes, one byte, as complete measures every credential (credentialSize), and gives complete's code before the voucher is signed. Each row runs on mpp/session/evm (B2's authorization opening, B6's funding signature) and mpp/session/tempo (B2's opening, B6's signed transaction): the challenge is padded by a description so that the credential complete gives the row's funding with a one-byte voucher signature measures the row's size. A taken row's voucher gives the voucher's typed data, and complete that credential; otherwise both give the row's code.

a voucher whose credential is one over the credential size bound

inChannelSize.about: One rule covers the credentials in a channel: a buildWithin's complete measures the in-channel credential it would return, and a session pairing's channel.kind, channel.ref and channel.boundWithin measure the payment they are given before they read it, with credentialSize's bound and code, as bound measures every credential. Each row runs on the five pairings with a buildWithin (mpp/session/evm, mpp/session/tempo on v2, mpp/session/hedera, mpp/session/solana and mpp/session/xrpl): mpp-session-within.test.ts's within challenge and held opening for each, a voucher, completed with one signature of the pairing's form. The within challenge is padded by a description so that the in-channel credential measures the row's size. A taken row's credential is what complete returns, and channel.kind, channel.ref and channel.boundWithin answer it as they answer the same credential without the description; otherwise complete and each of the three give the row's code. The two session pairings with channel members and no buildWithin, mpp/session/lightning and mpp/subscription/tempo, run the rows on channel.kind, channel.ref and channel.boundWithin alone, given the pairing's opening (credentialSize's credential) padded the same way.
